const copy = value => parseBounded(canonical(value));
const exact = (value, keys) => value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    && Object.keys(value).sort().join('|') === [...keys].sort().join('|');
const text = (value, max, field) => {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim() || value.length > max) throw Error(`Invalid ${field}.`);
    return value;
};
const time = value => typeof value === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d\.\d{3}Z$/.test(value)
    && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) && new Date(value).toISOString() === value;
const id = value => typeof value === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[1-8][a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/.test(value);
const escapeHtml = value => String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, char =>
    ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[char]));

function configure(options) {
    if (typeof options.engineSource !== 'string' || options.engineSource.length > 1000000) throw Error('Invalid engine source.');
    engineSource = options.engineSource;
    deployment = options.deployment ? copy(options.deployment) : null;
}

function tableCsv(table) {
    return [table.headers, ...table.rows].map(row => row.map(cell =>
        '"' + String(cell).replaceAll('"', '""') + '"').join(',')).join('\n') + '\n';
}

function createProject({ name = 'My SUCCESSOR Ω', goal = 'Reconcile two public catalogs and retain a reusable method.' } = {}) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    return { schema: VERSION, id: crypto.randomUUID(), revision: 0, name: text(name, 80, 'name'),
        goal: text(goal, 2000, 'goal'), createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, cycles: [], opportunities: [],
        qualification: 'not_independently_qualified', authority: 'none' };
}

function validateCycle(cycle) {
    if (!exact(cycle, ['id', 'createdAt', 'sourceHash', 'mission', 'result', 'origin'])) throw Error('Invalid cycle fields.');
    if (!id(cycle.id) || !time(cycle.createdAt) || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(cycle.sourceHash)
        || cycle.origin !== 'local_engineering_run') throw Error('Invalid cycle identity.');
    alpha.validateJoinMission(cycle.mission);
    const r = cycle.result;
    alpha.verifyExperiment(cycle.mission, r);
    if (!r || r.schemaVersion !== 1 || r.missionKind !== 'catalog_join'
        || !Array.isArray(r.strategies) || r.strategies.length !== alpha.STRATEGIES.length
        || r.assessment?.externalAuthority !== false || r.assessment?.independentReview !== 'pending'
        || r.assessment?.superiorityClaim !== false) throw Error('Invalid local result scope.');
    const ids = r.strategies.map(s => s.strategyId);
    if (canonical(ids) !== canonical(alpha.STRATEGIES.map(s => s.id))) throw Error('Invalid comparison methods.');
    for (const strategy of r.strategies) {
        if (!strategy.verified || !strategy.metrics || !Number.isSafeInteger(strategy.metrics.elapsedMicros)
            || strategy.metrics.elapsedMicros < 0) throw Error('Invalid recorded measurement.');
        alpha.verifyJoinResult(cycle.mission, strategy.pairs);
    }
    // Imported measurements remain historical even when their output can be recomputed.
    alpha.buildArtifacts(cycle.mission, r);
}

function inspectProject(serialized) {
    const p = typeof serialized === 'string' ? parseBounded(serialized) : copy(serialized);
    if (!exact(p, ['schema', 'id', 'revision', 'name', 'goal', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt', 'cycles',
        'opportunities', 'qualification', 'authority']) || p.schema !== VERSION || !id(p.id)
        || !time(p.createdAt) || !time(p.updatedAt) || !Number.isSafeInteger(p.revision) || p.revision < 0
        || p.qualification !== 'not_independently_qualified' || p.authority !== 'none'
        || !Array.isArray(p.cycles) || p.cycles.length > 6 || !Array.isArray(p.opportunities)
        || p.opportunities.length > 12) throw Error('Unsupported or invalid SUCCESSOR project.');
    text(p.name, 80, 'name'); text(p.goal, 2000, 'goal');
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const cycle of p.cycles) {
        if (seen.has(cycle.id)) throw Error('Duplicate cycle identity.');
        seen.add(cycle.id); validateCycle(cycle);
    }
    for (const opportunity of p.opportunities) validateOpportunity(opportunity);
    return p;
}

function serializeProject(dossier) {
    return canonical(inspectProject(dossier));
}

function renameProject(dossier, name) {
    const next = inspectProject(dossier);
    text(name, 80, 'name');
    if (next.name !== name) {
        next.name = name; next.revision += 1; next.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    }
    return next;
}

function appendCycle(dossier, { mission, result, sourceHash }) {
    const next = inspectProject(dossier);
    if (next.cycles.length >= 6) throw Error('This project contains six full cycles. Export it before starting a separate project.');
    const cycle = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), sourceHash,
        mission: copy(mission), result: copy(result), origin: 'local_engineering_run' };
    validateCycle(cycle);
    next.cycles.push(cycle); next.revision += 1; next.updatedAt = cycle.createdAt;
    canonical(next);
    return next;
}

function planOpportunity(fields) {
    const keys = ['goal', 'currentApproach', 'alternative', 'target', 'evidence', 'budget'];
    if (!exact(fields, keys)) throw Error('Unsupported opportunity fields.');
    const p = { schema: 'alpha-opportunity/v1', state: 'hypothesis',
        ...Object.fromEntries(keys.map(key => [key, text(fields[key], 2000, key)])),
        nextExperiment: 'Freeze a measurable target and compare one candidate with the current approach and a credible alternative.',
        independentReview: 'not_commissioned', authority: 'none' };
    return p;
}

function validateOpportunity(p) {
    if (!exact(p, ['schema', 'state', 'goal', 'currentApproach', 'alternative', 'target', 'evidence',
        'budget', 'nextExperiment', 'independentReview', 'authority']) || p.schema !== 'alpha-opportunity/v1'
        || p.state !== 'hypothesis' || p.independentReview !== 'not_commissioned' || p.authority !== 'none') {
        throw Error('Invalid opportunity scope.');
    }
    for (const key of ['goal', 'currentApproach', 'alternative', 'target', 'evidence', 'budget', 'nextExperiment']) {
        text(p[key], 2000, key);
    }
}

function addOpportunity(dossier, fields) {
    const next = inspectProject(dossier);
    if (next.opportunities.length >= 12) throw Error('Export this project before recording more opportunities.');
    next.opportunities.push(planOpportunity(fields)); next.revision += 1; next.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return inspectProject(next);
}

function estimateValue(input) {
    if (!input || typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input)
        || Object.keys(input).some(k => !['beforeMinutes', 'afterMinutes', 'runsPerMonth', 'hourlyValueCents', 'setupCents'].includes(k))) {
        throw Error('Unsupported value estimate fields.');
    }
    const { beforeMinutes, afterMinutes, runsPerMonth, hourlyValueCents, setupCents = 0 } = input;
    const values = { beforeMinutes, afterMinutes, runsPerMonth, hourlyValueCents, setupCents };
    if (Object.values(values).some(v => !Number.isSafeInteger(v) || v < 0 || v > 1000000)) throw Error('Use whole, nonnegative values up to 1,000,000.');
    const product = BigInt(beforeMinutes - afterMinutes) * BigInt(runsPerMonth) * BigInt(hourlyValueCents);
    const magnitude = ((product < 0n ? -product : product) + 30n) / 60n;
    const monthlyCents = Number(product < 0n ? -magnitude : magnitude);
    const netFirstMonthCents = monthlyCents - setupCents;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(monthlyCents)) throw Error('Estimate exceeds supported range.');
    return { schema: 'alpha-value-estimate/v1', inputs: values, monthlyCents, netFirstMonthCents,
        breakEvenMonths: monthlyCents > 0 ? Math.ceil(setupCents / monthlyCents) : null,
        status: 'user_supplied_assumptions', realizedValueMeasured: false,
        excludes: ['unentered operating costs', 'unentered integration costs', 'risk and error costs'] };
}

function prepareHandoff(dossier, route = 'USDC') {
    const p = inspectProject(dossier);
    if (!['USDC', 'AGIALPHA'].includes(route)) throw Error('Choose USDC or AGIALPHA explicitly.');
    return { schema: 'alpha-unfunded-work-brief/v1', projectId: p.id, projectRevision: p.revision,
        route, state: 'unfunded_draft', goal: p.goal, name: p.name,
        market: route === 'USDC' ? 'AGIJobManager' : 'AscensionJobMarket / AGI Jobs v0',
        deployment: route === 'AGIALPHA' && deployment ? copy(deployment) : null,
        sourceCycles: p.cycles.map(c => ({ id: c.id, sourceHash: c.sourceHash })),
        packages: ['Implement or improve the scoped capability', 'Challenge correctness and omitted requirements',
            'Independently evaluate a frozen candidate against competitive alternatives'],
        requiredBeforeCommission: ['named owner and independent reviewer', 'exact inputs and permitted rights',
            'candidate and comparator commitments', 'protected evaluation protocol', 'acceptance criteria',
            'price, deadlines and reviewer capacity', 'explicit funding and authorization'],
        qualification: 'not_independently_qualified', authority: 'none', transactionPrepared: false };
}

function buildReport(mission, result, { name = 'SUCCESSOR Ω', goal = 'Reconcile public catalogs.', language = 'en' } = {}) {
    alpha.validateJoinMission(mission);
    alpha.verifyExperiment(mission, result);
    const fr = language === 'fr', rec = result.reconciliation;
    const title = fr ? 'Votre résultat utile' : 'Your useful result';
    const rows = result.strategies.map(s => '<tr>' + [s.label, s.pairs.length, s.metrics.logicalOperations,
        s.metrics.indexedRows, s.metrics.elapsedMicros].map(v => '<td>' + escapeHtml(v) + '</td>').join('') + '</tr>').join('');
    return '<!doctype html><html lang="' + (fr ? 'fr' : 'en') + '"><meta charset="utf-8">'
        + '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">'
        + '<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src \'none\'; style-src \'unsafe-inline\'; base-uri \'none\'; form-action \'none\'">'
        + '<title>' + escapeHtml(name) + '</title><style>body{margin:3rem auto;padding:0 1.2rem;max-width:65rem;color:#261c39;background:#faf7ff;font:17px/1.65 system-ui}h1{font-size:2.5rem}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}td,th{padding:.7rem;border:1px solid #d8cde8;text-align:left}.scroll{overflow:auto}small{color:#514563}</style>'
        + '<h1>' + title + ' · ' + escapeHtml(name) + '</h1><p>' + escapeHtml(goal) + '</p><p>'
        + escapeHtml(`${mission.left.rows.length} × ${mission.right.rows.length}`) + (fr ? ' lignes source' : ' source rows')
        + ' · ' + rec.matchedPairs + (fr ? ' correspondances' : ' matched pairs') + ' · ' + rec.unmatchedLeft.length
        + ' / ' + rec.unmatchedRight.length + (fr ? ' lignes sans correspondance' : ' unmatched rows') + ' · '
        + rec.conflicts.length + (fr ? ' paires en conflit' : ' conflicting pairs') + '</p><div class="scroll"><table><thead><tr>'
        + (fr ? ['Méthode', 'Paires', 'Opérations logiques', 'Lignes indexées', 'Temps local (µs)']
            : ['Method', 'Pairs', 'Logical operations', 'Indexed rows', 'Local time (µs)']).map(v => '<th>' + v + '</th>').join('')
        + '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table></div><h2>' + (fr ? 'Portée des preuves' : 'Evidence scope')
        + '</h2><p>' + (fr ? 'Résultat local vérifiable. Les mesures temporelles sont descriptives; la qualification indépendante et la valeur économique réalisée restent à établir.'
            : 'Locally checked result. Timings are descriptive; independent qualification and realized economic value remain unestablished.')
        + '</p><ul>' + result.measurementNotes.map(v => '<li>' + escapeHtml(v) + '</li>').join('')
        + '</ul><p><small>SUCCESSOR Ω · Alpha Agent · Apache-2.0</small></p></html>';
}

function buildCapability(mission, result) {
    alpha.validateJoinMission(mission);
    alpha.verifyExperiment(mission, result);
    if (!engineSource) throw Error('The reusable engine source is unavailable. Save your project and use the repository CLI.');
    const selected = result.candidateStrategyId;
    if (!alpha.STRATEGIES.some(s => s.id === selected)) throw Error('Unsupported strategy.');
    return engineSource + '\n' + `
import {readFile, mkdir, writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {constants} from 'node:fs';
import {resolve, join} from 'node:path';
import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
  const [leftFile, rightFile, leftKey, rightKey, output] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (!leftFile || !rightFile || !leftKey || !rightKey || !output) {
    console.error('Usage: node successor-tool.mjs left.csv right.csv leftKey rightKey NEW-output-directory');
    process.exitCode = 2;
  } else {
    const fsStat = await import('node:fs/promises');
    const readBounded=async path=>{
      const initial=await fsStat.stat(path);
      if(!initial.isFile()||initial.size>200000)throw Error('Input must be a regular CSV file up to 200 KB.');
      const handle=await fsStat.open(path,constants.O_RDONLY|constants.O_NONBLOCK);
      try {
        const stat=await handle.stat();
        if(!stat.isFile()||stat.size>200000)throw Error('Input must be a regular CSV file up to 200 KB.');
        const bytes=Buffer.alloc(200001);
        let used=0;
        while(used<bytes.length){
          const {bytesRead}=await handle.read(bytes,used,bytes.length-used,null);
          if(bytesRead===0)break;
          used+=bytesRead;
        }
        if(used>200000)throw Error('CSV exceeds 200 KB.');
        return new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(bytes.subarray(0,used));
      }finally{await handle.close();}
    };
    const mission=createJoinMission({leftCsv:await readBounded(leftFile),rightCsv:await readBounded(rightFile),leftKey,rightKey});
    const result=await runJoinExperiment(mission);
    const files=buildArtifacts(mission,result);
    await mkdir(output,{recursive:false});
    for(const [key,name] of Object.entries({joinedCsv:'joined.csv',unmatchedLeftCsv:'unmatched-left.csv',unmatchedRightCsv:'unmatched-right.csv',conflictsCsv:'conflicts.csv',exactJson:'exact-result.json'})) {
      await writeFile(join(output,name),files[key],{encoding:'utf8',flag:'wx'});
    }
    await writeFile(join(output,'comparison.json'),JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\\n',{flag:'wx'});
    console.log('Reconciliation complete. Results are local engineering evidence; independent qualification remains pending.');
  }
}
`;
}

}

// Discovery planning uses the existing Alpha project codec. It grants no authority.
const discoveryIds=['needs','purpose','existing','gap','why','restriction','structure','alternatives','construction','arrangement','experiment','falsifier','checkpoint'];
let discoveryOrigin='user-supplied hypothesis',discoveryBase=null,discoveryImported=null,discoveryVersion=0,discoverySavedVersion=-1,discoverySavedText=null;
function discoveryInput(){
const value={};for(const id of discoveryIds)value[id]=$('discovery-'+id).value.trim();
value.cap=$('discovery-cap').value.trim()?Number($('discovery-cap').value):NaN;value.decision=$('discovery-decision').value;
return value;
}
// BEGIN DISCOVERY PLANNING HELPERS
function discoveryPlanFields(input,origin,sourceHash){
const limits={needs:600,purpose:600,existing:500,gap:500,why:400,restriction:600,structure:500,alternatives:600,construction:500,arrangement:500,experiment:500,falsifier:500,checkpoint:500};
for(const [key,maximum]of Object.entries(limits))if(typeof input[key]!=='string'||input[key].length>maximum)throw Error('INVALID_DISCOVERY');
if(!input.needs.trim()||!input.purpose.trim()||!Number.isSafeInteger(input.cap)||input.cap<0||input.cap>1000000||!['continue','revise','stop'].includes(input.decision))throw Error('INVALID_DISCOVERY');
if(typeof origin!=='string'||origin.length>120||typeof sourceHash!=='string'||!/^([0-9a-f]{64})$/.test(sourceHash))throw Error('INVALID_DISCOVERY');
const known=text=>text.trim()||'Unspecified; remains a hypothesis.';
return {goal:'Needs and beneficiaries: '+input.needs+'\nOriginal purpose and requirements: '+input.purpose,
currentApproach:'Existing approaches: '+known(input.existing)+'\nBinding restriction: '+known(input.restriction),
alternative:'Possible shared structure: '+known(input.structure)+'\nDifferent approaches: '+known(input.alternatives)+'\nProposed construction: '+known(input.construction),
target:'Unresolved gap: '+known(input.gap)+'\nDecisive experiment: '+known(input.experiment)+'\nFalsifier: '+known(input.falsifier),
evidence:'Planning provenance: '+origin+'. No autonomous discovery, execution or commercial evidence is established.\nWhy now: '+known(input.why)+'\nArrangement hypothesis: '+known(input.arrangement)+'\nSource: '+sourceHash,
budget:'Assumed exploration ceiling USD '+input.cap+'. Planning decision: '+input.decision+'. No funds, permission, contract or authority.\nDependencies, checkpoint and stop: '+known(input.checkpoint)};
}
function discoveryMissing(input){
const missing=Object.keys({needs:0,purpose:0,existing:0,gap:0,why:0,restriction:0,structure:0,construction:0,arrangement:0,experiment:0,falsifier:0,checkpoint:0}).filter(key=>!input[key]?.trim());
const alternatives=(input.alternatives??'').split('\n').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
if(new Set(alternatives).size<2)missing.push('different formulations');
return missing;
}
// END DISCOVERY PLANNING HELPERS
function renderDiscovery(){
const value=discoveryInput(),empty=say('Still to specify','À préciser');
setText('discovery-provenance',discoveryImported?say(`Imported Alpha project: ${discoveryBase.opportunities.length} recorded hypotheses. Its original history is preserved. Editing starts an additional hypothesis. No authority was restored.`,`Projet Alpha importé : ${discoveryBase.opportunities.length} hypothèses enregistrées. L’historique original est préservé. Une modification commence une hypothèse supplémentaire. Aucune autorité restaurée.`):discoveryOrigin.startsWith('supplied')?say('The example’s needs, shared structure, instrument and arrangement are supplied by its authors. Selecting them is not autonomous discovery. Edit any assumption for your own bounded exploration.','Les besoins, la structure commune, l’instrument et l’arrangement de cet exemple sont fournis par les auteurs. Les sélectionner n’est pas une découverte autonome. Modifiez toute hypothèse pour votre exploration bornée.'):say('Your entries are planning assumptions until independently supported. A complete business case is not required to record a useful exploratory question.','Vos saisies restent des hypothèses jusqu’à leur confirmation indépendante. Un dossier d’affaires complet n’est pas requis pour enregistrer une question exploratoire utile.'));
if(discoveryImported){const p=discoveryImported;pairs($('discovery-witness'),[[say('Original goal / requirements','But / critères originaux'),p.goal],[say('Existing restriction','Restriction existante'),p.currentApproach],[say('Proposed replacement','Remplacement proposé'),p.alternative],[say('Experiment and falsifier','Expérience et réfutation'),p.target],[say('Recorded evidence scope','Portée des preuves'),p.evidence],[say('Bounded decision','Décision bornée'),p.budget],[say('Inherited authority','Autorité héritée'),say('NONE','AUCUNE')]]);}else pairs($('discovery-witness'),[[say('Original purpose','But original'),value.purpose||empty],[say('Binding restriction','Restriction décisive'),value.restriction||empty],[say('Replacement hypothesis','Hypothèse de remplacement'),value.construction||value.structure||empty],[say('Falsifying observation','Observation réfutante'),value.falsifier||empty],[say('Planning choice','Choix de planification'),({continue:say('Continue bounded exploration','Continuer l’exploration bornée'),revise:say('Revise before construction','Réviser avant de construire'),stop:say('Stop; preserve resources','Arrêter ; préserver les ressources')})[value.decision]],[say('Assumed ceiling / committed cash','Plafond supposé / fonds engagés'),(Number.isSafeInteger(value.cap)?usd(value.cap):empty)+' / '+usd(0)]]);
const missing=discoveryMissing(value);setText('discovery-completeness',discoveryImported?say('This is an imported historical hypothesis. Technical qualification, buyer commitments, complete costs and current authority require their own evidence.','Il s’agit d’une hypothèse historique importée. }

// BEGIN COMPARISON RESULT HELPERS
function comparisonView(report){
if(!report||!Number.isSafeInteger(report.planned_cases)||report.planned_cases<1||report.planned_cases>16||!Array.isArray(report.cells)||report.cells.length!==report.planned_cases*3)return null;
const roles=['U','E','E+'],seen=new Set(),cases=new Set(),arms=Object.fromEntries(roles.map(role=>[role,{planned:0,accepted:0,unknown:0}]));
for(const cell of report.cells){if(!cell||!roles.includes(cell.role)||typeof cell.case_id!=='string')return null;const id=JSON.stringify([cell.case_id,cell.role]);if(seen.has(id))return null;seen.add(id);cases.add(cell.case_id);const arm=arms[cell.role];arm.planned++;const accepted=cell.accepted===true&&cell.outcome_known===true&&cell.status==='accepted-finite-placement'&&/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(cell.execution_digest??'')&&/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(cell.acceptance_digest??'');arm.accepted+=Number(accepted);arm.unknown+=Number(!cell.outcome_known||(cell.accepted&&!accepted));}
if(cases.size!==report.planned_cases||roles.some(role=>arms[role].planned!==report.planned_cases))return null;
return {arms,accepted:roles.reduce((total,role)=>total+arms[role].accepted,0),planned:report.cells.length,complete:report.current_evidence_valid===true&&roles.every(role=>arms[role].unknown===0),operational:arms.E.accepted-arms.U.accepted,retained:arms['E+'].accepted-arms.E.accepted};
}
// END COMPARISON RESULT HELPERS

function renderComparisonEvidence(){
if(typeof COMPARISON_EVIDENCE==='undefined')return;
const report=COMPARISON_EVIDENCE.stages[$('comparison-stage').value],view=comparisonView(report);
if(!view){setText('comparison-status',say('Incomplete or inconsistent evidence. No verified comparison can be shown.','Preuves incomplètes ou incohérentes. Aucune comparaison vérifiée disponible.'));$('comparison-outcomes').replaceChildren();$('comparison-contrasts').replaceChildren();$('comparison-attempts').replaceChildren();return;}
setText('comparison-status',say(`${view.accepted}/${view.planned} planned deliveries currently have eligible independent finite acceptance. ${view.complete?'All planned outcomes are assessed.':'Missing or unassessed cases remain visible.'}`,`${view.accepted}/${view.planned} livraisons prévues ont actuellement une acceptation finie indépendante admissible. ${view.complete?'Tous les résultats prévus sont évalués.':'Les cas absents ou non évalués restent visibles.'}`));
table($('comparison-outcomes'),[say('Condition','Condition'),say('Current accepted / planned','Acceptées actuellement / prévues'),say('Unassessed','Non évaluées')],['U','E','E+'].map(role=>[role,`${view.arms[role].accepted} / ${view.arms[role].planned}`,String(view.arms[role].unknown)]),say('Complete prospective denominator','Dénominateur prospectif complet'));
const increment=(number,baseline,candidate)=>`${number>0?'+':''}${number} / ${report.planned_cases}`+(view.complete?'':say(` · unresolved range [${number-view.arms[baseline].unknown}, ${number+view.arms[candidate].unknown}]`,` · intervalle non résolu [${number-view.arms[baseline].unknown}, ${number+view.arms[candidate].unknown}]`));
const extraKnown=['U','E','E+'].every(role=>report.arms?.[role]?.cost_complete===true);
const modelEvidenceLabels={'no-executions':['No bound execution records','Aucun enregistrement d’exécution lié'],'bound-executions-without-model-io-evidence':['Bound execution; no model request boundary recorded','Exécution liée ; aucune frontière de requête modèle enregistrée'],'model-request-evidence-unresolved':['Model request or boundary evidence unresolved','Requête modèle ou preuve de frontière non résolue'],'simulated-model-protocol-fixture':['Scripted fixture responses recorded; no live provider proof','Réponses fictives scriptées enregistrées ; aucune preuve de fournisseur réel'],'recorded-model-responses-provider-unverified':['Responses recorded; provider provenance unverified','Réponses enregistrées ; provenance du fournisseur non vérifiée'],'actual-model-records-with-unqualified-attribution':['Historical bound records; model I/O unverified','Enregistrements historiques liés ; entrées/sorties modèle non vérifiées']};
const modelEvidenceLabel=typeof report.model_evidence==='string'&&Object.hasOwn(modelEvidenceLabels,report.model_evidence)?modelEvidenceLabels[report.model_evidence]:['Unknown model evidence; no verified live-operation claim','Preuve modèle inconnue ; aucune exécution réelle vérifiée revendiquée'];
const historicalKnown=report.cells.every(cell=>typeof cell.historical_acceptance_recorded==='boolean');

Real Alpha remains unmeasured.','Autorité actuelle, coûts fictifs complets et limites figées satisfaits. const statuses={'not-attempted':say('Not attempted','Non tenté'),'accepted-finite-placement':say('Independent finite acceptance','Acceptation finie indépendante'),'acceptance-unassessed':say('Acceptance pending','Acceptation en attente')};

}

function renderInsight(){
  const evidence=INSIGHT_EVIDENCE, chosen=$('insight-candidate').value;
  $('insight-candidate').replaceChildren();
  for(const row of evidence.candidate_dossier){const option=document.createElement('option');option.value=row.id;option.textContent=row[language]||row.en;$('insight-candidate').appendChild(option);}
  if(evidence.candidate_dossier.some(row=>row.id===chosen))$('insight-candidate').value=chosen;else $('insight-candidate').value='usable-research-access';
  const candidate=evidence.candidate_dossier.find(row=>row.id===$('insight-candidate').value);
  const findings={
    'calibration-cohort':say('Rejected for this increment: shared access and proficiency testing are established; material quality and liability evidence is unavailable.','Piste écartée ici : accès partagé et essais d’aptitude établis ; preuves de qualité des matériaux et de responsabilité indisponibles.'),
    'heat-access':say('Rejected for this increment: deployment needs local health, accessibility, transport and facility evidence.','Piste écartée ici : une mise en service demande des preuves locales de santé, d’accessibilité, de transport et d’installations.'),
    'usable-research-access':say('Selected for exploratory construction: compose resource, institution, data and method prerequisites. Existing procedures are substantial prior art; recipient need and novelty remain unresolved.','Retenue pour une construction exploratoire : composer les prérequis des ressources, institutions, données et méthodes. Les procédures existantes constituent des antériorités substantielles ; besoin réel et nouveauté restent non établis.')
  };
  setText('insight-candidate-detail',findings[candidate.id]);
  const ordinary=evidence.search_report.arms.find(row=>row.arm==='U');
  setText('insight-search-denominator',say(`Frozen search denominator: ${ordinary.denominator} units per arm. U: ${ordinary.counts.missing} missing; E: one supplied candidate, two rejected paths. No measured search advantage.`,`Dénominateur figé : ${ordinary.denominator} unités par groupe. U : ${ordinary.counts.missing} absentes ; E : une candidate fournie, deux pistes écartées. Aucun avantage de recherche mesuré.`));
  const challenge=evidence.conventional_challenge.summary;
  setText('insight-conventional',say(`Independent conventional construction matched ${challenge.exact_execution_parity} / ${challenge.complete} complete comparisons across ${challenge.total} authored cases; ${challenge.incomplete_cases.length} case stayed incomplete in both. The technical-breakthrough claim stops. This post-disclosure execution challenge leaves discovery advantage and customer usefulness untested.`,`La construction conventionnelle indépendante égale ${challenge.exact_execution_parity} / ${challenge.complete} comparaisons complètes sur ${challenge.total} cas rédigés ; ${challenge.incomplete_cases.length} cas reste incomplet dans les deux méthodes. La prétention de percée technique est abandonnée. Ce test d’exécution après divulgation ne mesure ni avantage de découverte ni utilité pour des clients.`));
  const episode=evidence.construction_cases.find(row=>row.case_id===$('insight-case').value), result=episode.result;
  const names={
    'institution-clearance':say('Institutional clearance required','Autorisation de l’institution requise'),
    'access-award':say('Resource allocation declared','Attribution de ressource déclarée'),
    'scope-check':say('Required method scope checked','Portée de la méthode vérifiée'),
    'local-adapter':say('Local data adapter; approval required','Adaptateur local ; autorisation requise'),
    'bounded-run':say('Bounded experiment; approval required','Expérience bornée ; autorisation requise')
  };
  const container=$('insight-construction');container.replaceChildren();
  const status=document.createElement('p');status.className='insight-status';status.dataset.state=result.status;status.textContent=result.status==='conditional-plan'?say('CONDITIONAL PATH CONSTRUCTED','CHEMIN CONDITIONNEL CONSTRUIT'):result.status==='no-plan'?say('NO PATH WITHIN THE ORIGINAL OBLIGATIONS','AUCUN CHEMIN RESPECTANT LES OBLIGATIONS'):say('INCOMPLETE — SEARCH BUDGET EXHAUSTED','INCOMPLET — BUDGET DE RECHERCHE ÉPUISÉ');container.appendChild(status);
  if(result.steps.length){const list=document.createElement('ol');list.className='check-list';for(const step of result.steps){const item=document.createElement('li');item.textContent=names[step.step_id]||step.purpose;list.appendChild(item);}container.appendChild(list);}
  const note=document.createElement('p');note.className='fine';note.textContent=say(`${result.pending_permissions.length} pending permissions · ${result.preserved_obligations.length} original obligations · authority granted: none.`,`${result.pending_permissions.length} autorisations en attente · ${result.preserved_obligations.length} obligations initiales · autorité accordée : aucune.`);container.appendChild(note);
  pairs($('insight-claims'),[
    [say('Discovery','Découverte'),say('Exploratory — no stronger headline earned','Exploratoire — aucune percée qualifiée')],
    [say('Technical construction','Construction technique'),say('Finite local witness checked; external acceptance absent','Témoin local fini vérifié ; acceptation externe absente')],
    [say('Operational Alpha: E − U','Alpha opérationnel : E − U'),say('Unmeasured','Non mesuré')],
    [say('Retained Alpha: E+ − E','Alpha retenu : E+ − E'),say('Unmeasured; no retention admitted','Non mesuré ; aucune rétention admise')]
  ]);
  const policy=evidence.economics.policies.find(row=>row.cost_case===$('insight-cost').value&&row.price_usd===Number($('insight-price').value));
  const forecast=policy.assessment, amount=forecast.expected_economic_contribution_micro_usd;
  const expected=Number(amount.numerator)/Number(amount.denominator)/1000000;
  const cost=Object.values(policy.components_usd_per_attempt).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  pairs($('insight-economics'),[
    [say('Assumed participants / capacity','Participants supposés / capacité'),`${policy.assumed_participants} / 4`],
    [say('A: complete modeled cost per attempt','A : coût complet modélisé par tentative'),usd(cost)],
    [say('Modeled campaign contribution after defaults/refunds','Contribution de campagne modélisée après défauts/remboursements'),usd(expected)],
    [say('Required fictional prefunding including reserve','Préfinancement fictif requis, réserve incluse'),usd(forecast.required_prefunding_micro_usd/1000000)],
    [say('B: additional retention / observed benefit','B : rétention supplémentaire / bénéfice observé'),say('USD 5 screen; USD 150 retention rejected / benefit unmeasured','Filtrage de 5 USD ; rétention de 150 USD rejetée / bénéfice non mesuré')],
    [say('C: optional research, separate from delivery','C : recherche facultative, distincte de la livraison'),say('USD 0 / 100 / 500 scenarios','Scénarios de 0 / 100 / 500 USD')],
    [say('Actual profit / collections','Profit réel / encaissements'),say('Unknown / USD 0','Inconnu / 0 USD')]
  ]);
  table($('insight-arrangements'),[say('Arrangement','Organisation'),say('A: low / base / high USD','A : basse / centrale / haute USD')],evidence.economics.arrangement_comparison.map(row=>[row[language==='fr'?'name_fr':'name_en'],row.cost_range_usd?row.cost_range_usd.map(value=>usd(value)).join(' / '):say('Complete outcome unestablished','Résultat complet non établi')]),say('Conditional full-outcome comparison; no actual sales','Comparaison conditionnelle du résultat complet ; aucune vente réelle'));
  setText('insight-transfer',say('Two fresh synthetic local processes reproduced checked paths; an ordinary library with identical information ties. Live authenticated transfer and retained-skill benefit remain unqualified.','Deux processus locaux sur de nouveaux cas synthétiques ont reproduit les chemins vérifiés ; une bibliothèque ordinaire au contenu identique les égale. Le transfert authentifié réel et le bénéfice de rétention restent non qualifiés.'));
  const sources=$('insight-sources');sources.replaceChildren();
  for(const source of evidence.sources){const p=document.createElement('p'),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=source.url;a.textContent=source.title;a.rel='noreferrer';p.appendChild(a);sources.appendChild(p);}
}
